**The free, open-source video editor for creators.** Animated captions, one-click Auto Edit, motion graphics and 4K export, with no subscription, no watermark and no account. Everything runs on your computer.

## 🆕 What's new in this version

- **📱 Proper 9:16 reframing**: landscape footage now fills vertical videos instead of sitting in a thin strip with black bars. Pick **Fill**, **Blurred background** or **Fit** per clip
- **🎯 Smart reframe**: finds the speaker or the action and keeps them in frame as they move. **📱 Make vertical** converts a whole project to 9:16, 1:1 or 4:5 in one click
- **✂️ Remove filler words**: cuts "um", "uh" and stutters automatically (optionally "like", "you know" and "I mean" too)
- **🎬 Auto B-roll**: drops your extra clips and photos over the speaker at natural pauses
- **⚡ Make a Short**: finds the best 30–60 seconds of a long video and turns it into a vertical Short with captions
- **🧩 Auto Edit presets**: Talking head, Vlog, Podcast clip and Music montage, each one click
- **🎨 New Elements tab**: 35 stickers (emoji, arrows, badges), 10 animated backgrounds, 7 overlays (light leak, bokeh, confetti, snow, sparkles, film dust, VHS) and 9 intro & outro templates
- **⭕ Shapes & split screen**: rounded or circle clips, and top/bottom or left/right split-screen layouts

## ✨ Everything else

25 animated caption styles · offline auto-captions (whisper.cpp) · Auto Edit (remove silences or cut to the beat) · 43 effects & transitions · animated text & lower thirds · auto zoom · auto-ducking · picture-in-picture & keyframes · voice noise reduction · 9:16 / 16:9 / 1:1 / 4:5 up to 4K

## ⬇️ Which file do I download?

| Your computer | File |
|---|---|
| Windows 10/11 | `…_x64-setup.exe` (or `.msi`) |
| Mac with Apple chip (M1–M4) | `…_aarch64.dmg` |
| Mac with Intel chip | `…_x64.dmg` |
| Linux | `.AppImage`, `.deb` or `.rpm` |

FFmpeg and whisper.cpp are included. For auto-captions, open **⚙ Settings → Auto captions** and download a model once.

**First launch:** on macOS, right-click the app → **Open** (it isn't notarized yet). On Windows, SmartScreen may ask: **More info → Run anyway**.

🐞 Found a bug or have an idea? [Open an issue](https://github.com/pankya1801/Clipmaster/issues/new/choose). If Clipmaster saves you a subscription, a ⭐ helps others find it.
